title: Satu Cap Lagi
subject: an office clerk in Semarang whose only pair of work shoes has been resoled so many times at the same shoe-repair kiosk that his stamp card is one stamp from a free repair, and now he is afraid to walk too carefully
caption: Indonesian blues-pop with Rhodes, mellow modern singer-songwriter blues. Rhodes electric piano with tremolo playing lazy minor-seventh chords, bottleneck slide guitar answering each vocal line, warm walking bass, laid-back drums with a shuffle feel and rimshot snare. Warm vintage mix, a little tape hiss, dry vocal. Smoky male baritone vocal, relaxed and wry, half-smiling delivery. 88 BPM, A minor. Mood of a small money joke told over coffee. No trap beat, no autotune, no big rock guitar solo, no gospel organ, no EDM.
lyrics:
[Intro - Rhodes chords, slide guitar lick]
[Verse 1]
Sepatu hitam cuma sepasang
Solnya ganti empat kali
Kios Pak Darto dekat pasar
Hafal langkahku dari jauh
[Pre-Chorus]
Kartu kecil di dompetku
Sembilan cap, kurang satu
[Chorus]
Satu cap lagi, gratis satu
Tinggal tunggu sol yang copot
Sekarang aku jalan pelan
Tapi diam-diam berharap robek
[Verse 2]
Hujan nggak, becek pun nggak
Trotoar mulus sepanjang jalan
Aku tendang kerikil kecil
Sepatuku masih kuat saja
[Chorus]
Satu cap lagi, gratis satu
Pak Darto ketawa lihat aku
Katanya, "Sepatumu terlalu bagus"
Aku jawab, "Itu salahmu"
[Outro - slide guitar, Rhodes fades]
Kartu kecil di dompetku
Masih sembilan, masih nunggu
